name: response-time
title: Serve has high response times
description: The load balancer recorded an average target response time of at least five seconds for 15 minutes.
investigation_steps: Check the load balancer response time metrics and identify what is causing the high response times.
Check ECS service health, application logs and recent deployments.
Test Serve itself to see if the service is degraded or experiencing issues, if its substantiated an incident should be raised.
